## What this changes

## Checklist

- [ ] No connection identifiers, API keys, server paths or emails in any committed file
- [ ] Screenshots have property names and traffic figures masked
- [ ] New tools are read-only
- [ ] `dimensions` is fixed in the node for any tool with a calculation behind it
- [ ] Looping tools have a hard cap on API calls
- [ ] Tool description states what it does, what it needs, what comes back, and when to use it over a neighbouring tool
- [ ] `note` fields in responses preserved
